name: Minors or young adults funded by third parties
description: Accounts of young customers receive small repeated funds from unrelated adults, followed by cash-out.
fp: Gifting from relatives and part-time work are normal.

sources.text: FATF, Financing of the Terrorist Organisation Islamic State in Iraq and the Levant (ISIL) (2015)
UN Security Council Resolution 2178 (2014) on foreign terrorist fighters
